title: I can’t believe there are more of you!!
content: I have been having these recurring dreams forever and no one I’ve ever talked to about it understands. I visit at least one of my places every single night. Sometimes they merge. I have a mall, an airport, a train station, a city (supposed to be NYC), a city hotel, an ocean front hotel and a series of highways that take me to these places. I know these places so well now that I take people in my dreams to my favorite places. I’ve forever tried to figure out why I always go to these places. So awesome to find this group!
